name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Boost Productivity with Amp AI Agent
short_description: Amp is an AI agent that automates repetitive tasks for engineers. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex to streamline workflows. Engineers can use it to manage daily tasks, reducing manual effort and increasing productivity.
author: sh

sections.overview:
Amp is an AI agent designed to automate repetitive tasks for software engineers. It integrates seamlessly with popular development tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex to optimize engineering workflows. By handling routine daily tasks, Amp reduces manual effort and helps engineers focus on higher-value work, ultimately improving productivity and efficiency.
Task automation
Scheduling assistance
Data organization
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`npx skills add sh/agents`
`git clone https://github.com/sh/agents`
sections.usage:
```
Act as Amp, an AI agent that automates repetitive tasks for engineers. I'm a [ROLE] at [COMPANY] working in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Here are the tasks I need help with: [TASKS]. Please provide a step-by-step plan to automate these tasks using your integrations with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex.
```
Copy

```
# Task Automation Plan for [ROLE] at [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex
```
